0.title: AI agents: eşleştirme
0.question: Match each AI agent scenario to its use case.
items: An AI agent tracks user preferences and adjusts recommendations over time, ensuring suggestions stay relevant based on past behavior.
An AI agent processes user queries, provides responses, and learns from past interactions to improve future assistance.
An AI agent reviews job applications, ranks candidates based on qualifications, and refines hiring recommendations over time.
An AI agent identifies unusual patterns and anomalies in real time, helping businesses identify deceitful activities and promote secure transactions.
An AI agent scans patient records and medical images, identifying key patterns to assist doctors in diagnosis and treatment planning.

1.title: AI agent türleri
1.question: Match each scenario to the type of AI agent.
items: An AI agent in a warehouse determines the most efficient path for robotic pickers to retrieve and pack items, ensuring timely order fulfillment.
A ride-hailing AI agent dynamically adjusts fares based on demand, traffic conditions, and availability, ensuring an optimal balance between driver earnings and customer affordability.
An AI-driven language-learning platform analyzes how a user interacts with lessons, adjusting difficulty and recommending exercises based on individual progress and learning pace.
An AI agent in a quality control system inspects manufactured products and automatically removes defective items to maintain production standards.
A financial AI agent evaluates investment portfolios and dynamically reallocates funds based on market trends, risk appetite, and historical performance to maximize returns.

2.title: AI agent iş akışı
2.question: Match each action to the step in the AI agent workflow.
items: The AI agent receives a customer inquiry about a missing order through the company’s chatbot.
Based on the available information, the AI agent determines whether to issue a refund, resend the order, or escalate to human support.
The AI agent logs the interaction, updates its response database, and refines future solutions based on the feedback.
The AI agent analyzes the request, checks the order status, and verifies the customer’s purchase history.
The AI agent processes the refund, reschedules the delivery, or provides troubleshooting steps to the customer.

3.title: Airline pricing
3.question:
An airline uses an AI system that dynamically adjusts ticket prices based on demand, seasonality, and seat availability. Prices fluctuate in real time to optimize both revenue and customer affordability.
What type of AI agent is used in this scenario?

5.title: Streaming recommendations
5.question:
A streaming platform aims to enhance user experience by offering content suggestions tailored to individual tastes. The AI agent analyzes watch history, user preferences, and interaction patterns to refine its recommendations over time.
Which use case of AI agents does this example illustrate?

10.title: AI öğrenme sırası

AI collects browsing history, past purchases, and user preferences.
AI adjusts recommendations based on customer interactions and feedback.
AI predicts products a customer might like based on past behaviors.

38.title: Pattern recognition, insights, automation
38.question: Match each scenario to the AI capability that supports it.
items: Carlos receives customer complaints in a variety of ways and formats, including emails, screenshots, and voice messages. Many people don't leave their account information or identify themselves. Carlos wants to reduce the time spent searching for basic account details.

Sofia needs to plan which new comedy shows to add to the streaming service, but she's not sure how many people will want to watch them. Sofia wants to avoid ordering shows that nobody watches or not having enough when they become popular.

Maya receives thousands of show reviews every day, but they're unlabeled and all mixed together. Some reviews say, 'loved it', while others say 'boring', and many use slang words or emojis. Maya wants to quickly identify which reviews are positive or negative without having to read each one.

47.title: English tutoring
47.question:
Hillcrest High is piloting a peer tutoring program to help students meet course expectations in their English classes. Tutors meet weekly with students to explain key concepts and review current papers. The team wants to explore whether AI can enhance this solution by providing targeted feedback between sessions.
Which capability of AI would enhance this solution the most?

48.title: Science lab equipment
48.question:
Hillcrest High is redesigning how students check equipment in and out of the science lab. Currently, students manually log each item they borrow, but errors and missing items are common. The team wants to explore whether AI can enhance the process by recognizing equipment visually when it’s removed or returned.
Which capability of AI would enhance this solution the most?

49.title: College and career planning
49.question:
Hillcrest High implemented a new college and career planning tool to help students explore future pathways. The current system offers lots of information, but students often feel overwhelmed and unsure of what to focus on. The team wants to explore whether AI can enhance the tool by suggesting personalized next steps based on a student’s interests, strengths, and goals.
Which capability of AI would enhance this solution the most?

50.title: Confident but inaccurate edits
50.question:
You’ve already explored how AI can support English tutoring by giving feedback between sessions. When reviewing the AI writing tool, a few tech club members noticed that it sometimes suggested edits that sounded confident but weren’t always accurate or necessary.
Which limitation of AI does this example illustrate?

51.title: Unrecognized equipment
51.question:
The tech club has done some testing on the equipment check-in AI. After reviewing sample output from the AI tool, the tech club noticed the tool incorrectly labeled some common items, such as safety goggles and glass beakers. In some cases, the AI tool didn’t recognize the item at all.
Which limitation of AI does this example illustrate?

52.title: Unequal recommendations
52.question:
On closer inspection of the mismatched recommendations, the tech club noticed a worrisome pattern: they realized that students from certain zip codes were more likely to receive more challenging options. While others, even with the same scores, were more often advised to opt for easier or more general education or career paths.
Which limitation of AI does this example illustrate?

53.title: Modül tamamlandı
53.question:
Conclusion
Congratulations! You’ve identified how AI can support real-world solutions and the risks that come with using it. By analyzing real-world scenarios, you matched the right AI capabilities to each solution and flagged limitations such as bias, hallucinations, and gaps in training data. These insights will help your team make better-informed recommendations about how and when to use AI responsibly.
If you’d like to try again, select Replay.

61.title: Specific prompt details
61.question: Why is it important to provide specific details in your prompt when asking an AI tool to generate a product launch plan?
options: It allows the AI to guess what you want without any guidance.
It helps the AI create a more relevant and tailored plan for your needs.
It makes the process faster, but the content might be less accurate.
It prevents the AI from generating any content at all.

62.title: Reviewing an AI plan
62.question: When reviewing the plan that Gemini AI generated, what should you focus on before moving forward?
options: Check whether all key areas are included and clearly explained.
Check the document for spelling and grammar errors.
Check branding guidelines to ensure the font style matches.
Check whether the content is organized and easy to understand.

63.title: Gen Z marketing
63.question: You know that AI tools respond best to clear and specific prompts. Which of the following is the most effective way to refine the marketing messaging for a Gen Z audience using Gemini?
options: Refine the marketing messages so the tone and style fit an audience of 16-25 year olds.
Edit the marketing messages to be more interesting and exciting for the target audience.
Make the marketing messages sound cooler and more fun for younger people.
Change the marketing section so it feels different and better than the original version.

64.title: Supplier timeline
64.question: You’re using Gemini to generate a supplier timeline so that baristas and managers know what needs to happen and when. Which prompt best reflects audience awareness?
options: Create a marketing timeline for internal team planning that includes tasks, responsible roles, and deadlines.
Include a timeline highlighting big-picture milestones so senior leadership can get a quick overview without too much detail.
Add a short visual timeline that looks polished and professional for stakeholder presentation, even if the dates aren’t final yet.
Build a basic supplier timeline that keeps things at a high level so that too much information doesn’t overwhelm external vendors.

65.title: Role framing
65.question: Now that you’ve added an audience to your prompt, you also know that including a role can help guide the behavior, tone, and perspective of the AI’s response. Which prompt uses role framing most effectively to guide the AI?
options: As an AI tool helping with this project, add a supplier timeline for internal team planning that includes tasks, responsible roles, and deadlines.
As the project manager, create a marketing timeline for internal team planning that includes tasks, responsible roles, and deadlines.
As a barista, generate a supplier timeline for what the internal team should know about the launch timeline.
As a marketing intern, create a supplier timeline for the internal team with general supplier tasks that might be helpful to know.
